config.tenthslot.title: Tenth Slot
config.tenthslot.showOnlyWhenHotbarFull: Show Only When Hotbar Is Full
When enabled, the tenth slot is only shown when all 9 hotbar slots are occupied.
config.tenthslot.vanillaOffhandActions.d: When disabled, offhand item actions are blocked while the tenth slot is selected (using items, placing blocks, eating, drinking, etc.).
config.tenthslot.vanillaNonItemRightClic: When disabled, non-item right-click interactions are blocked while the tenth slot is selected (opening doors, mounting, trading, opening block GUIs, etc.).
config.tenthslot.vanillaLeftClick.desc: When disabled, left-click interactions are blocked while the tenth slot is selected (attacking entities, breaking blocks).
